terms.definitionEn: A JavaScript function whose returned React elements describe a reusable part of the UI.
terms.definitionAr: دالة JavaScript بترجع React elements بتوصف جزء قابل لإعادة الاستخدام من الواجهة.

terms.definitionEn: Read-only inputs supplied by a parent to configure a component instance.
terms.definitionAr: مدخلات للقراءة بس بيبعتها الأب عشان يحدد إعدادات نسخة الـ component.

terms.definitionEn: One named input value passed from a parent component to a child component.
terms.definitionAr: قيمة مدخل واحدة باسم محدد بتتنقل من parent component للـ child.

terms.definitionEn: The prop containing content nested between a component's opening and closing tags.
terms.definitionAr: الـ prop اللي فيها المحتوى المكتوب بين وسم فتح وقفل الـ component.

terms.definitionEn: Building a UI by combining smaller components and passing content or behavior between them.
terms.definitionAr: بناء الواجهة بدمج components أصغر وتمرير المحتوى أو السلوك بينهم.

terms.definitionEn: Extracting named prop values from the props object in a component parameter or function body.
terms.definitionAr: استخراج قيم props مسماة من object بتاع props في parameter أو جسم الدالة.

terms.definitionEn: A fallback assigned through a parameter default when a prop is missing or undefined.
terms.definitionAr: قيمة بديلة بتتحدد كـ default للـ parameter لما prop تكون غايبة أو undefined.

terms.definitionEn: A component that renders another component and supplies its props or nested content.
terms.definitionAr: component بتعرض component تانية وبتبعتلها props أو محتوى متداخل.

terms.definitionEn: A component rendered within another component's returned UI tree.
terms.definitionAr: component بتتعرض جوه شجرة الواجهة اللي بترجعها component تانية.

terms.definitionEn: A design pattern where data is passed from parent components down to their descendants through props.
terms.definitionAr: نمط بيانات بيمرر القيم من components الأبناء للي تحتها عن طريق props.

terms.definitionEn: The rule that a component treats the values it receives as inputs rather than modifying them.
terms.definitionAr: قاعدة إن component تتعامل مع القيم المستلمة كمدخلات وماتغيرهاش.

terms.definitionEn: The identity React uses to determine whether a rendered component can preserve its state across updates.
terms.definitionAr: هوية React بتحدد إذا كان component المعروض يقدر يحتفظ بحالته بين التحديثات.

questions.question: What makes Greeting a function component?
options: It is a function that returns React UI elements
It must be called manually from the browser console
It creates a DOM node as soon as the function is declared
It receives state automatically without using a Hook
questions.explanation: A function component returns elements that describe its UI.
questions.explanationAr: الـ function component بترجع elements بتوصف واجهتها.

questions.question: What value is read from props.name?
options: The string 'name' from the component declaration
The string 'Rana' supplied by the parent
A state value created by React
The component's function name
questions.explanation: The parent passes name='Rana', available on the props object.
questions.explanationAr: الأب بيبعت name='Rana' وبتكون موجودة على object props.

questions.question: What does the parameter syntax do?
options: It creates state named text inside Label whenever the component renders
It renames the Label component to text for all JSX imports
It extracts the text prop from the props object
It makes text a global variable shared by every component in the app
questions.explanation: Object destructuring binds the text property to a local parameter variable.
questions.explanationAr: تفكيك الـ object بيربط خاصية text بمتغير محلي.

questions.question: Where does Panel receive the strong element?
options: In a prop named content by default
As the value of a generated state variable
Through the DOM after Panel finishes rendering
In its children prop
questions.explanation: Nested JSX between component tags is passed as the children prop.
questions.explanationAr: JSX المتداخل بين وسمي component بيتبعت في prop اسمها children.

questions.question: What value does tone have when this component is called?
options: 'blue', from the parameter default
undefined, because React ignores JavaScript defaults
null, because a missing prop becomes null
An empty string inserted by JSX
questions.explanation: The destructured parameter default is used when the prop is undefined.
questions.explanationAr: القيمة الافتراضية بتستخدم لما الـ prop تكون undefined.

questions.question: What does this component composition pattern enable?
options: Panel can mutate the parent's element tree in place during each render
A parent can reuse Panel with different nested UI content
The section element becomes a React state container that stores its children
Every child is automatically converted to a string before reaching the browser
questions.explanation: Accepting children lets callers compose different content inside the reusable Panel.
questions.explanationAr: استقبال children بيسمح للمستدعي يركب محتوى مختلف جوه Panel.

questions.question: Why should a component avoid this prop mutation?
options: React props can never contain object values, only strings and numbers
The assignment automatically schedules a state update in the parent component
Props are inputs; changing them breaks the read-only data flow
A component is allowed to change only string props but not object properties
questions.explanation: A child should treat props as read-only and ask its owner to update data.
questions.explanationAr: الـ child يتعامل مع props كقراءة بس ويطلب من المالك تحديث البيانات.

questions.question: What relationship does this JSX express?
options: Card is declared within the Profile function body and cannot be reused elsewhere
Profile is passed as a string prop to Card rather than rendered as an element
Profile replaces Page as the application root and prevents Card from rendering
Page composes Card with Profile as nested children
questions.explanation: The Profile element is nested content passed to Card through children.
questions.explanationAr: عنصر Profile محتوى متداخل بيتبعت لـ Card عن طريق children.

questions.question: What does React use to decide whether Child keeps its state at the rendered position?
options: The component type and its position, along with any key
The source-code line where the function was written
The text returned by the component on the previous render
The name of every prop passed by Parent
questions.explanation: React associates state with a component's identity in the rendered tree, including type, position, and key.
questions.explanationAr: React بيربط الحالة بهوية component في الشجرة، ومنها النوع والمكان والـ key.

questions.question: What text does Greeting render?
options: Hello name
Hello Lina
Greeting Lina
Hello undefined
questions.explanation: The name prop supplies Lina, which is inserted into the paragraph.
questions.explanationAr: الـ prop name فيها Lina وبتتحط في النص.

questions.question: What text appears in the span?
options: New
label
Hot
undefined
questions.explanation: A provided prop value is used instead of the default.
questions.explanationAr: قيمة الـ prop المبعوتة بتستخدم بدل القيمة الافتراضية.

questions.question: What text is rendered by the nested child?
questions.explanation: The bold element is passed as children and renders its text content.
questions.explanationAr: عنصر bold بيتبعت في children وبيظهر النص اللي جواه.

questions.prompt: Declare a function component named Greeting.
questions.explanation: A function component is declared as a JavaScript function.
questions.explanationAr: الـ function component بتتعرّف كدالة JavaScript.

questions.prompt: Read the name prop from the props object.
questions.explanation: Props are read by their named property.
questions.explanationAr: الـ props بتتقري باستخدام اسم الخاصية.

questions.prompt: Render the content nested between Card's tags.
questions.explanation: The children prop contains nested content supplied by the caller.
questions.explanationAr: prop children فيها المحتوى المتداخل اللي بعتته component المستدعية.

questions.prompt: Set a fallback label when the prop is undefined.
questions.explanation: A destructured parameter can assign a default with an equals sign.
questions.explanationAr: parameter المتفكك ينفع يحدد قيمة افتراضية بعلامة يساوي.

questions.prompt: Destructure the title property in the component parameter.
questions.explanation: Destructuring binds the named prop as a local variable.
questions.explanationAr: التفكيك بيربط الـ prop المسمى بمتغير محلي.

questions.prompt: Pass the Profile component as nested Card content.
questions.explanation: Nested JSX is passed as the receiving component's children.
questions.explanationAr: JSX المتداخل بيتبعت كـ children للـ component المستقبلة.

questions.prompt: Pass a callback prop from this parent to the child.
questions.explanation: A function value can be passed as a prop for the child to call.
questions.explanationAr: ينفع تبعت قيمة دالة كـ prop عشان الـ child تناديها.

questions.prompt: Use the conventional prop containing nested JSX content.
questions.explanation: React places nested component content in the children prop.
questions.explanationAr: React بتحط المحتوى المتداخل في prop اسمها children.

questions.question: What are props, and why should a child component treat them as read-only?
keyPoints: Props are inputs supplied by a parent
They flow down the component tree
Updates should be requested through callbacks or owner state
questions.modelAnswer: Props are inputs a parent supplies to configure a child. Treating them as read-only keeps data flow predictable and prevents a child from silently mutating an owner's data. A child can request changes by calling a callback that the parent provides.
questions.explanation: Read-only props preserve one-way ownership of data.
questions.explanationAr: الـ props للقراءة بس وده بيحافظ على ملكية البيانات واتجاهها.

questions.question: How does the children prop support component composition?
keyPoints: It carries nested elements from the caller
A component decides where or whether to render them
It lets reusable wrappers accept different content
questions.modelAnswer: JSX nested between a component's tags is passed through children. The component can render that content in a chosen place or conditionally omit it. This lets a wrapper such as a panel remain reusable with different inner UI.
questions.explanation: Children separate a wrapper's structure from the content supplied by its caller.
questions.explanationAr: children بتفصل هيكل الـ wrapper عن المحتوى اللي بيبعتُه المستدعي.

questions.question: How do default values in destructured props work?
keyPoints: The default is used when the prop value is undefined
An explicitly supplied value takes precedence
The default does not replace null
questions.modelAnswer: A default in a destructured parameter is used if the prop is missing or its value is undefined. A supplied value takes precedence, and null is still an explicit value rather than triggering the default. Defaults are ordinary JavaScript parameter behavior.
questions.explanation: The distinction between undefined and null follows JavaScript default-parameter semantics.
questions.explanationAr: الفرق بين undefined وnull راجع لسلوك default parameters في JavaScript.

questions.question: What is component composition, and why is it useful?
keyPoints: Larger interfaces can be built from smaller components
Components can be nested and receive props or children
Composition supports reuse without a single rigid component
questions.modelAnswer: Composition builds a larger interface from smaller components that each own a focused part of the UI. Parents can pass configuration through props and nested content through children. This supports reuse while allowing each screen to arrange components for its needs.
questions.explanation: Composition favors combining focused components over one monolithic component.
questions.explanationAr: التركيب بيجمع components مركزة بدل component واحدة ضخمة.
